description: This file defines the RequestCompressionMiddleware class within the Aws namespace, which is used to compress HTTP request payloads in the AWS SDK for PHP. It implements middleware logic to handle request compression based on configuration and request/operation parameters.

classes.name: RequestCompressionMiddleware
classes.description: Middleware class for compressing HTTP request bodies in AWS SDK for PHP.

methods.name: wrap
methods.description: Static method to create a wrapper function for middleware instantiation with configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing middleware with next handler and configuration.

methods.name: __invoke
methods.description: Invokes the middleware to potentially compress the request based on logic and configuration.

methods.name: compressRequestBody
methods.description: Compresses the request body using the determined encoding.

methods.name: determineEncoding
methods.description: Selects the encoding method for compression based on available encodings.

methods.name: shouldCompressRequestBody
methods.description: Determines whether the request body should be compressed based on configuration and request parameters.

methods.name: hasStreamingTraitWithoutRequiresLength
methods.description: Checks if operation input members involve streaming without requiring length.

methods.name: determineMinimumCompressionSize
methods.description: Calculates the minimum size for compression based on config.

methods.name: isValidCompressionSize
methods.description: Validates that a compression size is a non-negative integer within allowed bounds.
